# Comprehensive Indian Trade & Export Compliance Data

## 1. ICEGATE Compliance Information Portal (CIP)
**Note:** The ICEGATE CIP portal (https://foservices.icegate.gov.in/cip/cip#/) is a JavaScript-based application requiring interactive login and session handling. The portal provides product-specific compliance data (HS codes, policy status, duties, licensing requirements) but cannot be fully extracted via static scraping. For specific HS-code queries, visit the portal directly.

**Key Data Points from DGFT Cross-Reference:**

### Import/Export Policy Status (DGFT ITC-HS Schedule)
- **ITC(HS) Classification**: India uses HS/ITC(HS) codes (up to 8 digits)
- **Policy Categories**: Free, Restricted, or Prohibited per product
- **Current Master**: FTP 2023-28 with ongoing amendments

### Customs Duties & Taxes
- **Basic Customs Duty (BCD)**: Varies by product (0-150%)
- **Social Welfare Surcharge**: 10% on BCD
- **IGST**: Applicable on imports (5%/12%/18%/28% slabs)
- **Anti-Dumping Duty**: Specific products
- **Cess**: Product-specific (e.g., Compensation Cess on solar cells)
- **Exemptions**: Available under SEZ, EOU, Advance Authorisation, EPCG, Notification-based schemes

### Required Licences & Approvals
- **IEC (Importer-Exporter Code)**: Mandatory for all trade (5-digit PAN-based)
- **RCMC (Registration-Cum-Membership Certificate)**: From respective export promotion councils
- **Specific Licences**: Subject to product code (e.g., chemical, pharmaceutical, defence)
- **Regulatory Agencies**: FSSAI (food), CDSCO (drugs), AGMark (agricultural), BIS (standards), Plant Quarantine (agricultural imports)

### Compliance Framework
- **DGFT eCom App**: Online application for advance authorisation, EPCG, certificates of origin
- **ICEGATE Integration**: Automated customs clearance with DGFT licence verification
- **SIMS**: Steel Import Monitoring System for regulated commodities

---

## 2. DGFT — Import/Export Policy, Notifications & Regulations

### Import/Export Policy Amendments
| Notification No. | Description | Date |
|---|---|---|
| 46/2026-27 | Amendment in Export Policy of Agarwood under Chapter 12, Schedule-2 ITC (HS) Export Policy | 30/10/2026 |
| 36/2026-27 | Fixation of four new Standard Input-Output Norms (SIONs) at SION Nos. A-3715, A-3716, A-3717, A-3718 | 23/10/2026 |
| 33/2026-27 | Constitution of Sub-Committee for Resilience & Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation | 30/10/2026 |
| 32/2026-27 | Amendments and Clarifications to the Guidelines for Support for Alternative Trade Instruments | 26/10/2026 |
| 31/2026-27 | Advisory against M/s Julfikar Fashions Limited, Bangladesh as per para 8.07(d) of Foreign Trade Policy | 21/10/2026 |

### Export Authorisation & Licensing
- **Advance Authorisation**: Duty-free import of inputs for export production (FTP Para 16)
- **EPCG (Export Promotion Capital Goods)**: Import of capital goods at zero duty against export obligation (FTP Para 15)
- **Physical Export**: Export of goods from India
- **Mean of Performance**: Foreign Exchange Realisation (FER)
- **RoDTEP**: Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (rebate of embedded central/state taxes)
- **Rodtep Rate**: Available for most product categories per tariff lines

### Restricted/Prohibited Product Updates
- **Agarwood (Chapter 12)**: Export policy amendment (Notification 46/2026-27, 30 Oct 2026)
- **Unauthorised Access Advisory**: Advisory issued against specific exporters for DSC misuse (Notification 31/2026-27)

### Key DGFT Resources
- **Foreign Trade Policy**: https://www.dgft.gov.in/CP/?opt=ft-policy
- **ITCHS Import-Export Policy**: https://www.dgft.gov.in/CP/?opt=itchs-import-export
- **Notifications**: https://www.dgft.gov.in/CP/?opt=notification
- **Public Notices**: https://www.dgft.gov.in/CP/?opt=public-notice
- **Handbook of Procedures**: https://www.dgft.gov.in/CP/?opt=ft-procedures

---

## 3. Department of Commerce — Trade Intelligence & Analytics (TIA) & TradeStat

### Portal: https://trade-analytics.commerce.gov.in/public
**Key Features:**
- **Trading Partners**: 217+ countries
- **FTA Partners**: 53 countries with which India has FTAs
- **Traded Commodities**: 11,700+ commodity codes
- **Data Source**: DGCIS (Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics)

### Top Export Destinations (FY 2025-26 YTD)
1. USA
2. UAE
3. China
4. Netherlands
5. UK

### Top Import Sources
1. China
2. UAE
3. Russia
4. USA
5. Saudi Arabia

### Top Export Commodities
- Petroleum Products
- Electronic Goods
- Drugs & Pharmaceuticals
- Engineering Goods

### Top Import Commodities
- Petroleum & Crude Products
- Gold
- Electronic Goods

### Trade Data Dimensions Available
- **Classification**: HS2, HS4, HS6, HS8 codes
- **Trade Type**: Import, Export, or Both
- **Geography**: Country-wise, State-wise, District-wise, Port-wise
- **Metrics**: Value (USD) or Volume
- **Time Period**: Calendar Year (CY) or Financial Year (FY), Monthly granularity
- **Major FTA Destinations**: EU, UK, Japan, Australia, UAE, Singapore, Korea, ASEAN, USA

### Top Trading Regions
- NAFTA
- EUROPE
- WANA (West Asia & North Africa)
- NEA (North East Asia)
- ASEAN

### Port-wise & State-wise Data
- Port-wise export/import data available
- State-wise and District-wise export data available
- Commodity-wise trade contribution by sector

---

## 4. APEDA, DGFT & Product Regulators — Documentation Requirements

### Required Documents by Category

#### A. Export Promotion Councils (EPCs) / Product-specific Boards
| Document | Purpose | Issuing Authority | Applicability |
|---|---|---|---|
| **RCMC** (Registration-Cum-Membership Certificate) | Mandatory for claiming export benefits | Relevant EPC/Board (APEDA, MPEDA, FIEO, etc.) | All exporters of respective product categories |
| **Phytosanitary Certificate** | Plant and plant product exports | Plant Quarantine Authority | APEDA-regulated products |
| **Certificate of Origin** | Preferential tariff treatment under FTAs | DGFT / Authorized Chambers | Export to FTA partner countries |
| **Health Certificate** | Food, meat, dairy exports | FSSAI / Animal Quarantine | Agricultural and food products |
| **Inspection Certificate** | Quality verification | Approved agencies (PSIA list) | As per product-specific requirements |

#### B. APEDA (Agricultural Products)
- **Document Name**: RCMC + Phytosanitary Certificate
- **When Required**: For all agricultural product exports
- **Issuing Authority**: APEDA (https://apeda.gov.in)
- **Applicability**: Speculated in APEDA Schedule products
- **Validity**: Continuous (subject to renewal as per EPC norms)
- **Mandatory**: Yes, for claiming benefits

#### C. MPEDA (Marine Products)
- **Document Name**: RCMC + Health Certificate / HACCP Certification
- **Issuing Authority**: MPEDA (https://mpeda.gov.in)
- **Applicability**: Marine products export

#### D. Coffee Board, Tea Board, Spices Board, Rubber Board, Tobacco Board
- Each has product-specific RCMC and certification requirements

### Document Application Procedure
1. Register with relevant Export Promotion Council/Board
2. Obtain RCMC online via DGFT eCom portal
3. Apply for product-specific certificates through authorized agencies
4. Attach to shipping bill at customs

### Official Links
- APEDA: https://apeda.gov.in
- MPEDA: https://mpeda.gov.in
- DGFT Certificate of Origin: https://www.trade.gov.in/pages/certificate-of-origin
- Pre-Shipment Inspection: https://www.dgft.gov.in/CP/?opt=psia

---

## 5. Free Trade Agreements — Preferential Tariff & Rules of Origin

### India's Major FTAs (53 FTA Partners)

#### A. India-UK CETA (Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement)
- **Participating Countries**: India, United Kingdom
- **Status**: Concluded; implemented
- **Preferential Rates**: Duty-free or reduced duty on specified goods
- **Rules of Origin**: Preferential Tariff Origin criteria per schedule
- **Certificate of Origin**: Self-declaration or certifying authority

#### B. India-EU FTA
- **Participating Countries**: India, European Union
- **Status**: Concluded (January 2026)
- **Eligible Products**: Thousands of product lines
- **Preferential Tariffs**: Per schedule in Agreement
- **Origin Criteria**: WO (Wholly Obtained) / SPI (Sufficient Processing Indirect) / CCS (Change in Tariff Classification)

#### C. India-UAE CEPA
- **Participating Countries**: India, UAE
- **Preferential Rates**: Gradual elimination of duties
- **Origin Criteria**: Regional Value Content (RVC), CCS

#### D. India-Japan EPA
- **Participating Countries**: India, Japan
- **Preferential Tariffs**: As per schedule

#### E. India-Korea CEPA
- **Participating Countries**: India, Korea
- **Preferential Rates**: As per schedule

#### F. India-Australia ECTA/ICEA
- **Participating Countries**: India, Australia
- **Preferential Tariffs**: Implementation ongoing

#### G. India-New Zealand CECA (Amended)
- **Participating Countries**: India, New Zealand
- **Status**: Landmark renegotiated FTA concluded December 2025

#### H. Other Notable FTAs
- ASEAN-India FTA
- India-Singapore CECA
- India-Mauritius CECPA
- India-Bahrain CEPA
- India-Oman CEPA

### Rules of Origin Framework
- **WO (Wholly Obtained)**: For agricultural, mineral, and wholly produced goods
- **SPI (Sufficient Processing Indirect)**: Non-originating materials used
- **CCS (Change in Tariff Classification)**: HS code change at specified level
- **RVC (Regional Value Content)**: Minimum % of regional value
- **De Minimis**: Small proportion of non-originating materials permitted
- **Consolidation**: Specific rules for accumulated origin

### Exceptions & Quotas
- Sensitive product lists (negative lists) per FTA
- Trade remedy measures (safeguards, anti-dumping)
- Quota-based preferential access for specific products

### Official Resources
- Trade Connect FTA Portal: https://www.trade.gov.in/pages/free-trade-agreements
- India's FTAs: https://www.commerce.gov.in/files/2026-03/FTAs achievement v6 5 pm.pdf

---

## 6. Reserve Bank of India — FEMA, Payment & Realisation Rules

### Export Payment & Realisation Rules
- **Regulation**: FEMA 1999 as amended; RBI Master Direction on Foreign Exchange Management (Foreign Trade) Regulations, 2023
- **Realisation Requirement**: All export proceeds must be realised and repatriated to India
- **Timeline**: Within 9 months from date of export (as per Shipping Bill date)
- **Extensions**: RBI-authorized can grant extensions under specific conditions
- **LUT (Letter of Undertaking)**: Exporters can export without payment realization upfront, subject to subsequent realisation

### Import Payment Rules
- **Payment Obligation**: All imports must be paid through proper banking channels
- **AD Category-I Banks**: Only Authorized Dealer Category-I banks can facilitate forex transactions
- **LC/TT**: Payment by Letter of Credit or Telegraphic Transfer through AD banks
- **Timeline**: As per shipment/import documents

### Authorised Dealer Bank Requirements
- Only AD Category-I banks are authorized to deal in foreign exchange
- All export realisation and import payment must be routed through AD banks
- **eBRC (electronic Bank Realisation Certificate)**: Generated by AD banks on DGFT portal upon realisation of export proceeds

### Relevant FEMA Regulations & Circulars
- **Foreign Exchange Management (Foreign Trade) Regulations, 2023**: Consolidates all FT regulations
- **Master Direction on Foreign Exchange Management (Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2024**
- **RBI Circulars on eBRC**: Electronic Bank Realisation Certificate issued through DGFT portal
- **FEMA Compliance**: Non-compliance attracts penalties under FEMA

### Effective Dates & Amendments
- FTP 2023-28 currently in effect
- RBI Master Directions are updated periodically; latest version available on RBI website
- **RBI Portal**: https://www.rbi.org.in
